meta.title: quergedruckt | 3D Printing, Prototyping & Design
meta.description: Custom 3D printing, prototyping, and design services for innovators, makers, and businesses.

hero.description: Custom 3D printing, prototyping and design for innovators, makers and businesses.

about.label: About Us
about.title: From idea to finished part
about.description: quergedruckt turns digital designs into physical parts. We design, prototype and print, and we can scan an existing part when there is no drawing to work from. One idea or a small series, it all starts with a conversation about what you need.

features.insight: One contact from sketch to part

prototyping.title: Rapid Prototyping
prototyping.description: Hold your idea in your hands before you commit to it. Printed prototypes let you check shape, fit and function early, and change them quickly when something needs to be different.

design.title: Design & Engineering
design.description: No model yet? We can draw it. We design and adjust parts so they work in the real world and print well, whether you start from a sketch or an existing drawing.

printing.title: Custom 3D Printing
printing.description: Send us your file and we print it. One-off pieces and small batches, made in exactly the shape you need.

scanning.title: 3D Scanning
scanning.description: We capture a physical object as a digital 3D model. That makes it possible to copy, repair or adapt something that so far only exists on your workbench.

production.title: Production Parts
production.description: For parts that end up in real use, printing is often the more practical route in small quantities, because it needs no tooling. We are happy to talk through whether it makes sense for yours.

reverse.title: Reverse Engineering
reverse.description: A part is broken, no longer made or was never documented. We scan it, rebuild the model and work out how to make it again.

tech.title: Design and printing together
tech.description: Because we handle both the modelling and the printing, problems get solved in the design instead of at the printer. That spares you a few rounds of back and forth.

quality.title: Honest advice
quality.description: If a part will not print well as drawn, we say so and suggest a better way. Better to hear it before printing than after.

eco.title: One piece or many
eco.description: A single prototype is as welcome as a small series. We plan each job around what the part has to do.

projects.label: Our Projects
projects.title: A look at what we make

filament.title: Custom 3d printed filament
filament.description: Filament is the raw material of every print. Choosing and handling it with care is where good results start.

architecture.title: Architectural Building Model
architecture.description: A scale model lets people judge a building long before it exists. Printing captures facades, roof lines and fine details.

rcCar.title: 3D-Printed RC Car
rcCar.description: Many parts of a model car can be printed, from the body to small mechanical pieces. A good test of how well design and printing work together.

trophy.title: Champion Trophy Design
trophy.description: A trophy can take almost any shape. Printing lets you design a true one-off instead of choosing from a catalogue.

how.label: How It Works
how.title: From idea to part in three steps

design.title: Tell us your idea
design.description: Send a sketch, a drawing or a 3D file, or simply describe what you have in mind. We talk it through and work out what is needed.

printing.title: We print it
printing.description: Once the model is ready, we print it. If something needs adjusting, we tell you.

delivery.title: Get your parts
delivery.description: We agree with you in advance how and when the parts reach you.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.description: Feedback from people we have worked with.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Short answers to common questions. If yours is not here, just ask us.

speed.question: How fast is production?
speed.answer: That depends on the size of the part, the material and how many you need. Tell us what you have in mind and we will give you a realistic timeframe.

materials.question: What materials do you offer?
materials.answer: The right material depends on what the part has to do: carry load, withstand heat, look good, or all three. Tell us the purpose and we will recommend something that fits.

largeParts.question: Can you print large parts?
largeParts.answer: It depends on the part. Send us the dimensions and we will tell you what is possible.

noFile.question: Do I need a 3D file?
noFile.answer: No. If you have a sketch, a drawing or only the physical part, we can work from that. We draw or scan the 3D model for you.

designHelp.question: Do you provide design help?
designHelp.answer: Yes. We design and adjust parts for printing, from a first sketch to a print-ready model.

shipping.question: Where do you deliver?
shipping.answer: For now, we deliver within Germany only. We agree on how and when your parts reach you for every order. Need them shipped to another country? Send us an inquiry and we will let you know what is possible.

contact.title: Tell us what you want to make
contact.description: Send us a message with your idea, a sketch or a file. We read everything carefully, ask what we need to know and get back to you with a quote or the next step.
